_notes: Mitten State geography reference pack for the Michigan state-simulation game. PROVENANCE: every lat/lon below was read from the English Wikipedia coordinates API (en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php prop=coordinates) on 2026-10-06 and rounded to 4 decimals (~11m precision, plenty for game relative positions). No coordinate was guessed: any value that could not be verified would carry coord_status 'verify' with lat/lon null -- currently ALL entries are verified, zero 'verify' flags. Populations are approximate 2020-census-rounded gameplay values (NOT Wikipedia-verified, tune freely). Regions are game-design groupings (not official Michigan regions) that partition all 83 real Michigan counties with no overlaps; county lists are authoritative for membership, bboxes are rough gameplay guides and may overlap at edges. Highway polylines use verified city/town coordinates only; out-of-state anchors (Toledo OH) position the Michigan state-line ends. Mackinac Bridge landings are approximated by the verified Mackinaw City / St. Ignace city centers (bridge is ~8km; city-to-city span matches at game scale); bridge center is the verified Mackinac Bridge article coordinate. GODOT USE: load with JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(...)), project lon/lat to map space with an equirectangular projection scaled to your map rect, draw highways as Line2D through waypoint nodes, place cities as Node2D markers grouped by region, draw the bridge as a toll link between the two landings.

highways.name: I-75
highways.note: Main north-south spine: Ohio line to Detroit, Flint, Saginaw, then north through Grayling/Gaylord, across the Mackinac Bridge to St. Ignace, ending at Sault Ste. Marie.

highways.name: I-94
highways.note: East-west southern corridor: Indiana line via New Buffalo and Kalamazoo, through Jackson and Ann Arbor to Detroit, ending at Port Huron / Blue Water Bridge.

highways.name: I-96
highways.note: Muskegon to Detroit via Grand Rapids and Lansing. West terminus is Norton Shores (Muskegon anchor used).

highways.name: I-69
highways.note: Southwest to east: Indiana line near Coldwater, through Lansing and Flint, ending at Port Huron.

highways.name: I-196
highways.note: Gerald R. Ford Freeway: Benton Harbor to Grand Rapids via Holland.

highways.name: US-131
highways.note: North-south west Michigan: Indiana line near Three Rivers, through Kalamazoo and Grand Rapids, ending at Petoskey.

highways.name: US-23
highways.note: Sunrise Side route: Ohio line via Toledo, through Ann Arbor, Flint, Saginaw and Bay City, up the Lake Huron shore via Tawas and Alpena to Mackinaw City.

highways.name: US-127
highways.note: North-south central: Ohio line near Hudson, through Jackson and Lansing, ending at Grayling (I-75).

highways.name: US-31
highways.note: Lake Michigan shoreline route: Indiana line near Niles, through Muskegon and Ludington, around via Traverse City and Petoskey to Mackinaw City.

mackinac_bridge.note: Landings are approximated by the verified Mackinaw City / St. Ignace city centers; the true anchorages sit ~1-3km toward mid-bridge. At game scale, draw the bridge deck as a link south_endpoint -> center -> north_endpoint and treat it as a toll crossing between the North/Up North and Upper Peninsula regions.
